polls.text: I will be able to support draft-20 in Seattle. (No opinion if I have no implementation)

chat.author: Magnus Westerlund
chat.text: I lost audio

chat.author: Victor Vasiliev
chat.text: what is a locmaf

chat.author: Will Law
chat.text: Its a compression optimnization for CMAF

chat.author: Will Law
chat.text: locmaf.dev

chat.author: Victor Vasiliev
chat.text: Have we already formally adopted this draft?

chat.author: Torbjörn Einarsson
chat.text: https://locmaf.dev

chat.author: Magnus Westerlund
chat.text: No, but it will be needed to handle CMSF drafts requirements.

chat.author: Victor Vasiliev
chat.text: It seems a bit premature to issue a liason statement regarding a work that the working group has not decided to take on

chat.author: Yu You
chat.text: MPEG WG3 has intentions to work on the low complexity CMAF too. it is unknown what does it mean to locmaf

chat.author: Victor Vasiliev
chat.text: For what it's worth, I am personally skeptical about this working group taking on a third normative container format to specify at this point

chat.author: Cullen Jennings
chat.text: I think Magnus plan is good for locmaf

chat.author: Yu You
chat.text: a liaison letter

chat.author: Magnus Westerlund
chat.text: Victor it is not a third format, it is an optimization for CMSF.

chat.author: Cullen Jennings
chat.text: so just to clarify, the only changes from 20 to 21 are orgination and rewrite but not normative changes ?

chat.author: Torbjörn Einarsson
chat.text: I do have discussions with some people in the MPEG systems group, and some support there. It is compression of chain of CMAF fragments.

chat.author: Magnus Westerlund
chat.text: It is basically the equivalent to transfer-encoding specifically for some object contents in CMAF.

chat.author: Magnus Westerlund
chat.text: Will have to drop out be back in a while

chat.author: Giovanni Marzot
chat.text: +1 move plus editorial clarity

chat.author: Cullen Jennings
chat.text: I don't really care but 1 draft that has the move, and another that has the editorial is very easy

chat.author: Giovanni Marzot
chat.text: 21 i meant

chat.author: Steven Riedl
chat.text: FYI I posted an I-D last week, no agenda time needed — draft-riedl-moq-ad-creative-signaling-00, carrying SVTA 2053-1 ad creative signaling on an MSF Event Timeline track. Companion to Will's SCTE-35 event-timeline draft. https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-riedl-moq-ad-creative-signaling/ — feedback welcome whenever, aiming to say more at Seattle.

chat.text: on Secure object, we had consus in WG to move priority to something relays could change. Mo had good input on that which caused the change

chat.author: Zafer Gürel
chat.text: @Alan, we implemented switch_from in MOQtail (draft-18, so a partly implementation) and will share our feedback later with you.

chat.author: Mike English
chat.text: so long as objects are being delivered on different streams a receiver always as to have some tolerance for reordering, no?

chat.author: Mike English
chat.text: Is there anything that falls out of this with object canonicalization? I think that'd be my only concern

chat.author: Mike English
chat.text: ack ty

chat.author: Michal Hošna
chat.text: Object properties with multiple publisher is already non-canonical with SHOULD on replacing.

chat.author: Mike English
chat.text: Good point

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: yeah it's not a big deal, it's just strange to weaken object equality to save a single byte

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: I feel like the priority of saving a byte is too high lul

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: as the editor of the qpack spec, i lost many arguments of "this complexity doesn't justify the savings"

chat.author: Victor Vasiliev
chat.text: I think it's definitely very not compelling for subgroups

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: that would work

chat.author: Victor Vasiliev
chat.text: We currently have one default priority; we still have one unused bit to take it up to three default priorities. If you need more, it costs one byte per packet

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: I like Mo's idea

chat.author: Torbjörn Einarsson
chat.text: There are events which are live and then become vod.

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: I guess properties are currently immutable and now it's sorta not

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: sub_tracks would create duplicate PUBLISH?

chat.author: Mike English
chat.text: Overlapping NSes?

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: I would say for overlaps: 1) not a protocol error; (2) publishers MAY terminate duplicates if sub is being silly

chat.author: Martin Duke
chat.text: which is what duplicate subscribe should be to

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: so SUBSCRIBE and SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS only serves new objects, but afaik SUBSCRIBE_NAMESPACE serves old and new namespaces

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: sub tracks will solicit publish for already published tracks.

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: latest object I mean, the idea being you can update filters on SUBSCRIBE/SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS and it applies to any data going forward

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: anyway doesn't really matter ignore me

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: i think you misunderstood

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: Updating the filters on existing subscribe_tracks will only change filters on newly generated publishes.

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: the only way to update filters on existing subscriptions is with REQUEST_UDPATE

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text:
Updating the filters on existing subscribe_tracks will only change filters on newly generated publishes.

that's kind of weird? So you only catch brand new broadcasts with the new filters?

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: oh, maybe the disconnect is track property filters vs object property filters

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: so you have to issue a new SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS if you want the new filters to apply to old publishes?

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: If you change the track property filters -> you can get PUBLISH for existing subscriptions that match.

chat.author: Alan Frindell
chat.text: If a subscriber has an existing subscription - you can only update object property filters using REQUEST_UPDATE.  Cancelling all the subscriptions and issuing a new SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS with a differet filter set would also work, but seems heavy handed

chat.author: Victor Vasiliev
chat.text: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html#name-https-certificate-verificat appears to be the relevant normative text for webtrans

chat.author: Giovanni Marzot
chat.text: why no wildcards?

chat.author: Luke Curley
chat.text: I use wildcards for customer names

chat.author: Victor Vasiliev
chat.text: I am not sure how much we should require beyond "what RFC 9525 says"
